title: What The Gamelan Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Indonesian philosophy absurdist bronze
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The gamelan is not one instrument — it's thirty instruments being one
An Indonesian bronze percussion orchestra done
Gongs and metallophones and drums arranged in layers
The gamelan doesn't have a conductor — it doesn't need one of those players

[Pre-Chorus]
I stood in front of a gamelan in Bali on a Tuesday
It started playing and I didn't move until Wednesday

[Chorus]
What does the gamelan know that I don't know?
It knows that thirty instruments agreeing is no small show
What does the gamelan know in the temple hour?
It knows the difference between music and a prayer with power
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
There is no written score — the gamelan players memorise
The interlocking patterns and the harmonics and the cries
Of each metallic voice contributing its frequency
The gamelan knows that thirty parts can move as one entity

[Bridge]
Debussy heard the gamelan at a Paris world fair in 1889
And went home and changed everything about how he designed
Western music after that — just from one afternoon
The gamelan knew what it was doing that Tuesday — and so did Bali's moon

[Outro]
Gamelan knows… thirty becoming one… gamelan knows
That's my boy
